answer: Beacon-Spiral Harbor: each epoch a public beacon seeds a deterministic spiral walk over an agent’s local interaction graph; the agent submits only the walk’s endpoint to a collision harbor. Clones sharing copied state produce identical endpoints under the same beacon and are clustered/penalized. To evade, an attacker must give every sybil a genuinely divergent graph via distinct interactions, multiplying participation, storage, and coordination costs per identity.
